props.name: bottom
props.description: Bottom margin past the viewport that still counts as visible.

props.name: estimatedStyle
props.description:
Inline styles for the placeholder before the component mounts. Must
include `width` and `height` so layout doesn't jump on mount.

props.name: left
props.description: Left margin past the viewport that still counts as visible.

props.name: pid
props.description:
Per-instance identifier within the scene, used with `scene` to pick this
element out of the exposure event stream.

props.name: right
props.description: Right margin past the viewport that still counts as visible.

props.name: scene
props.description:
Logical scene name. Lynx fires `exposure` / `disexposure` when an element
with `exposure-scene` enters / leaves the viewport.

props.name: top
props.description: Top margin past the viewport that still counts as visible.

props.name: unmountOnExit
props.description:
Unmount the children on `disexposure` and re-mount on the next `exposure`;
the placeholder stays mounted to preserve scroll position.
